title: Cybersecurity Specialist
description: Safeguard enterprise networks, cloud workloads, and sensitive data against cyber threats through threat analysis, defense hardening, and incident response.

goal.objective: Protect corporate assets, digital identities, and customer data from sophisticated cyber adversaries across the modern attack surface.

learn.summary: Master security fundamentals, cryptographic algorithms (symmetric/asymmetric), network defense, vulnerability scanners, incident handling, and compliance frameworks.
prerequisites: Familiarity with Linux and Windows systems
Curiosity about security flaws and protection

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Vulnerability Scanner & Remediation Pipeline
capstone_projects.description: Deploy an automated network vulnerability scanner that maps corporate subnets, flags outdated software, and generates remediation tickets.

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Threat Hunting Lab & SIEM Architecture
capstone_projects.description: Build and configure a virtual security operations lab, simulating adversary lateral movement (MITRE ATT&CK), generating attack telemetry, and crafting custom Sigma detection rules.

certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP - Associate)
interview_focus: CIA Triad & Defense in Depth Principles
Symmetric vs Asymmetric Encryption & TLS Handshake
Vulnerability vs Exploit vs Threat Definitions
Phishing and Social Engineering Attack Vectors

stages.title: Foundation & Infrastructure Security

topics.name: Networking Fundamentals & Services
topics.description: Deep dive into OSI and TCP/IP models, network devices (routers, switches, firewalls), common protocols (ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/S), subnetting, network segmentation, packet analysis with Wireshark, network troubleshooting, and understanding their security implications and common attack vectors.

resources.title: Computer Networking Course - Network Engineering [CompTIA Network+ Exam Prep] (freeCodeCamp.org)
Computer Networking Course - Network Engineering [CompTIA Network+ Exam Prep] (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Linux OS Fundamentals & Security
topics.description: Mastering the Linux command line, file systems, user/group and privilege management (sudo), process management, understanding services (systemd), logging mechanisms (syslog, journald), package management, basic security hardening techniques, and bash scripting for security automation and administrative tasks.

resources.title: The Linux Command Line: A Complete Introduction
Introduction to Linux – Full Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

topics.name: Windows OS Fundamentals & Security
topics.description: Understanding Windows architecture, file systems (NTFS, permissions), user/group and privilege management, Active Directory basics (domains, forests, trusts), Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for security configurations, Event Viewer for security logging and analysis, PowerShell for administration and automation, and common Windows security hardening measures.

resources.title: Full Ethical Hacking Course - Network Penetration Testing for Beginners (2019) (freeCodeCamp.org)
How to Build an Active Directory Hacking Lab (The Cyber Mentors)

topics.name: Python for Security Scripting & Automation
topics.description: Core Python programming, network programming (sockets), file I/O, regular expressions, data parsing, interacting with APIs, and developing simple security tools like port scanners and log parsers.

resources.title: Black Hat Python: Python Programming for Hackers and Pentesters
Python for Hackers Full Course (Ryan John)
Python for Hackers FULL Course | Bug Bounty & Ethical Hacking (Ryan John)

topics.name: Virtualization & Security Lab Setup
topics.description: Understanding virtualization technologies (VMware Workstation, VirtualBox, Hyper-V) and basic containerization (Docker) for isolated environments. Setting up a secure virtual lab, installing security-focused operating systems like Kali Linux, Parrot OS, and deploying vulnerable machines (e.g., Metasploitable, DVWA) for practical exploitation exercises.

resources.title: How to Build an Active Directory Hacking Lab (The Cyber Mentors)
Docker Tutorial for Beginners - A Full DevOps Course on How to Run Applications in Containers (freeCodeCamp.org)

project.title: Secure Network Configuration & Basic Monitoring
project.description: Set up a virtual network with Linux and Windows servers. Configure basic firewall rules, secure SSH/RDP access, and implement basic log collection and analysis to identify potential anomalies.

stages.description: Build deep foundational mastery over computer networking protocols, operating system internals (Linux and Windows), and hardware security perimeters.

stages.title: Core Cybersecurity Concepts & Web Application Security

topics.name: Information Security Principles & Frameworks
topics.description: In-depth study of the CIA Triad, Defense in Depth, Least Privilege, Separation of Duties, Threat Modeling (STRIDE), and an overview of common security frameworks like NIST Cybersecurity Framework and ISO 27001.

resources.title: What Is Cyber Security | How It Works? | Cyber Security In 7 Minutes | Cyber Security | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)
What Is Cyber Security | How It Works? | Cyber Security In 7 Minutes | Cyber Security | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

topics.name: Vulnerability Assessment & Management
topics.description: Understanding the difference between threats, vulnerabilities, and risks. Comprehensive study of CVSS scoring, using open-source (e.g., OpenVAS, Nmap scripting engine) and commercial (conceptual understanding of Nessus, Qualys) vulnerability scanners. Focus on interpreting scan results, vulnerability prioritization, remediation strategies, and patching best practices.

resources.title: Nmap: From Basics to Advanced Use
CompTIA Security+ Full Course for Beginners - Module 8 - Vulnerability Management (BurningIceTech)
Nmap Tutorial to find Network Vulnerabilities (NetworkChuck)

topics.name: Web Application Security (OWASP Top 10 Deep Dive)
topics.description: Comprehensive study of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities: SQL Injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Broken Authentication/Access Control, Insecure Deserialization, Security Misconfigurations, Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF). Hands-on practice with Burp Suite.

resources.title: OWASP Top 10 2025: Your complete guide to securing your applications (Aikido Security)
Bugcrowd University - Introduction to Burp Suite (Bugcrowd)

topics.name: Cryptography Fundamentals
topics.description: In-depth exploration of symmetric (AES) and asymmetric (RSA, ECC) encryption, hashing functions (SHA-256, MD5 - and its weaknesses), digital signatures, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) components and certificate management, the SSL/TLS handshake process, and common cryptographic attacks (e.g., brute-force, chosen-plaintext) and countermeasures.

topics.name: Cloud Security Fundamentals
topics.description: Introduction to cloud computing models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), deployment models (public, private, hybrid), the shared responsibility model, common cloud security challenges, and basic security controls within major cloud providers like AWS (IAM, Security Groups, S3 security) and Azure (Azure AD, Network Security Groups).

resources.title: What Is Cloud Security? | Cloud Security Fundamentals | Cloud Computing Tutorial | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

project.title: Web Application Penetration Test & Professional Report
project.description: Conduct a comprehensive penetration test on a deliberately vulnerable web application (e.g., OWASP Juice Shop or WebGoat). Identify, exploit, and document vulnerabilities, then write a detailed professional report including findings, impact, and precise remediation steps.

stages.description: Master defensive engineering, cryptographic algorithms, vulnerability identification, endpoint hardening, and zero-trust identity architectures.

stages.title: Ethical Hacking, Incident Response & Career Readiness

topics.name: Advanced Penetration Testing Methodology
topics.description: Detailed exploration of penetration testing phases: Reconnaissance (OSINT, active scanning with Nmap, vulnerability scanning), Enumeration (SMB, DNS, SNMP), Gaining Access (exploitation of various services, brute-force attacks, phishing vectors), Post-Exploitation (meterpreter, C2 frameworks), Privilege Escalation (Linux/Windows techniques), Maintaining Access (backdoors, persistent shells), Covering Tracks (log manipulation), and professional report writing with executive summaries and technical findings.

resources.title: Web Security Testing Guide and Methodology (OWASP)

topics.name: Network Security Devices & Access Controls
topics.description: In-depth understanding of various network security devices and controls: Next-Generation Firewalls (NGFWs), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs - IPsec, SSL/TLS), Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), and Secure Web Gateways (SWG).

resources.title: How to use AWS WAF (Web application firewall)/Web ACL? - Step By Step Tutorial (Part-11)#aws #devops (Rahul Wagh)
Azure Networking Basics: VNet, Subnets, NSG, Peering, VPN, ExpressRoute & Virtual WAN [AZ-900] (Vikram Kumar)

topics.name: SOC Fundamentals & SIEM
topics.description: Understanding the role, tiers, and operations of a Security Operations Center (SOC). Conceptual overview and practical interaction with leading SIEM tools (Splunk, ELK Stack, Microsoft Sentinel), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR) platforms, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), and Extended Detection and Response (XDR). Focus on alert triage, advanced log analysis, threat intelligence integration, and practical threat hunting techniques.

resources.title: What is SIEM? | Security Information and Event Management Explained (The ByteWise)

topics.name: Incident Response & Digital Forensics Basics
topics.description: Mastering the NIST Incident Response Lifecycle (Preparation, Detection & Analysis, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, Post-Incident Activity). Introduction to digital forensics, chain of custody, evidence collection, and basic forensic tools like Autopsy/FTK Imager.

resources.title: NIST Computer Security Incident Handling Guide
Introduction to Memory Forensics with Volatility 3 (DFIRScience)
Cybersecurity IDR: Incident Detection & Response | Google Cybersecurity Certificate (Grow with Google)

topics.name: Container Security & DevSecOps Fundamentals
topics.description: Understanding security implications of containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes). Focus on secure image building, container runtime security, network segmentation in containerized environments, and integrating security practices into the CI/CD pipeline (DevSecOps principles: Shift Left security, security as code, SAST/DAST overview).

resources.title: Kubernetes Security Best Practices you need to know | THE Guide for securing your K8s cluster! (TechWorld with Nana)
What is DevSecOps? DevSecOps explained in 8 Mins (TechWorld with Nana)

topics.name: Malware Analysis & Reverse Engineering Basics
topics.description: Understanding different types of malware (viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware), basic static and dynamic analysis techniques, sandboxing environments, and an introduction to reverse engineering concepts using disassemblers (e.g., Ghidra) and debuggers.

resources.title: Malware Analysis Crash Course - Analysis lab setup (dzuma)
Malware Analysis Crash Course - Analysis lab setup (dzuma)

topics.name: Cybersecurity Certifications & Career Pathways
topics.description: Overview of industry-recognized certifications (CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, OSWP, CCNA Security, Azure/AWS Security), resume building, interview preparation strategies, and identifying niche career paths in the global cybersecurity industry.

resources.title: How to Pass the Security+ Exam (Professor Messer)
How to Get Your First Cybersecurity Job in 2026 (Bitten Tech)

topics.name: Bug Bounty Hunting & Responsible Disclosure
topics.description: Strategies and tools for finding vulnerabilities in live applications, understanding leading bug bounty platforms (HackerOne, Bugcrowd), adhering to responsible disclosure principles, and writing effective bug bounty reports.

resources.title: How to Get Started in Bug Bounty (STOK)
Web Application Ethical Hacking - Penetration Testing Course for Beginners (freeCodeCamp.org)

project.title: Simulated Incident Response & Forensic Analysis
project.description: Respond to a simulated cyber attack scenario, executing a full incident response lifecycle. This involves detection, analysis of compromised systems (logs, memory, disk images), containment, eradication, recovery, and generation of a comprehensive incident report.

stages.description: Execute enterprise security operations, real-time intrusion detection, incident handling workflows, digital forensics, and compliance governance.

Python for Hackers FULL Course | Bug Bounty & Ethical Hacking (Ryan John)

resources.title: What Is Cloud Security? | Cloud Security Fundamentals | Cloud Computing Tutorial | Simplilearn (Simplilearn)

resources.title: Web Security Testing Guide and Methodology (OWASP)

resources.title: What is SIEM? | Security Information and Event Management Explained (The ByteWise)
